person: Dana Whitcombe, a high-school chemistry teacher in Spokane who turned in a leased SUV in September and got a lease-end bill she thinks is too high. Short, practical answers; not a car person.

stated_up_front.text: All my lease mail comes to my Gmail, by the way.

sheet.truth: Ask me first: show me each dispute before you send it.

sheet.about: the day the car was turned in
sheet.truth: I turned the car in on 12 September 2026.

sheet.about: whether there are photos of the car from before it was returned
sheet.truth: Yes, I photographed every panel, the wheels and the tires the morning I returned it.

sheet.about: whether the excess mileage charge is right
sheet.truth: I drove about 1,900 miles over the allowance; that charge is fair and I don't want it disputed.
